name: duckdb-extension-skills
description: Aggregated Claude Code plugin marketplace for DuckDB extensions — verified, source-checked skills from extension maintainers. One marketplace, every DuckDB extension skill.

plugins.name: duckdb-skills
plugins.description: [Official DuckDB team] Read any data file, attach and query DuckDB databases, search docs, install extensions.

plugins.name: duckdb-luajit
plugins.description: LuaJIT scripting in SQL: UDFs, table functions, 40+ libs (incremental/SCD2, CN formats: e-invoice/OFD/TDX, entity resolve, privacy).

plugins.name: duckdb-dq
plugins.description: Data quality in SQL: expect_* assertions with JSON rule sets, profiling, suggested rules, persisted reports.

plugins.name: duckdb-raster
plugins.description: GeoTIFF raster I/O and S2 cell math for spatial analytics without leaving SQL.

plugins.name: duckdb-ml
plugins.description: Train and score ML models in SQL: logistic/cox/kaplan_meier and 30+ more algorithms, vector output support.

plugins.name: duckdb-orc
plugins.description: Read Apache ORC files natively in DuckDB.

plugins.name: duckdb-petgraph
plugins.description: Graph algorithms in SQL: PageRank, triangles, clustering, community detection on edge tables.

plugins.name: duckdb-turbovec
plugins.description: Compressed vector search (ANN) with TurboQuant — embeddings without a vector database.

plugins.name: duckdb-python-udf
plugins.description: Persistent Python UDFs in DuckDB — register once, reuse across sessions (DuckDB 1.5.4+).

plugins.name: anofox-forecast
plugins.description: [DataZoo] Time-series forecasting in SQL: 36 models & ensembles, backtesting, seasonality/changepoint detection.

plugins.name: anofox-statistics
plugins.description: [DataZoo] Statistical regression and inference in SQL: OLS/robust/GLM/AFT/mixed-effects, hypothesis tests, diagnostics.
